menu.settings.audio.subtitles.descriptio: Shows captions for sounds that have them. Each game must provide its own, matey.
menu.settings.audio.threshold.descriptio: Voice goes out only when yer microphone is louder than the line. Talk and drag it so the light comes on for yer speech, not the background noise.
menu.settings.audio.voice.description: How loud other shipmates sound when they speak.

menu.settings.audio.voicemode.descriptio: Push to talk sends only while ye hold the key. Open microphone sends whenever there’s sound.

menu.settings.dev.benchmark.description: Closes the menu, runs the standard benchmark packages, then shows ye the results.
menu.settings.dev.consoleoverlay.descrip: Draws console output over the game, so ye can read it without opening the console.
menu.settings.dev.consoleoverlay.title: Console Overlay
menu.settings.display.blurb: Yer window, resolution and frame rate.
menu.settings.display.fov.description: How wide the default camera sees, in degrees. Games may override this with their own, matey.
menu.settings.display.fps.description: The ceiling while ye’re in a game. 0 is uncapped. A limit just under yer refresh rate keeps frame pacing steadier than letting it run free.
menu.settings.display.fps_inactive.descr: The ceiling while yer window isn’t focused. Low is usually right — it returns the machine’s resources to whatever ye alt-tabbed to.
menu.settings.display.fps_menu.descripti: The ceiling while ye’re in the menu, outside a game. The menu rarely needs to work as hard as a game, matey.
menu.settings.display.mode.description: Borderless fills the screen at yer desktop resolution and alt-tabs instantly. Exclusive takes full control of the display, which can shave a frame of latency but is slower to leave.
menu.settings.display.resolution.descrip: How many pixels draw yer game. Borderless always uses the desktop resolution, so this applies only to the other two window modes.
menu.settings.display.vsync.description: Waits for the display before showing a frame. Removes tearing at the cost of some latency and caps ye to the refresh rate.
menu.settings.every_upscaler_renders_to_: Every upscaler renders to a target that can’t be multisampled, matey. This has no effect while one is on.
menu.settings.game.chat.description: Turns off the platform chat everywhere, including games that use it, matey.
menu.settings.game.language.description: The language for yer menu and any game that has a translation.
menu.settings.game.streamer.description: Hides names and other personal details that would otherwise end up on yer stream.
menu.settings.gfx.aa.description: Multisampling on geometry edges. Without it, foliage and hair fall back to a hard cutout. Worth having 2x aboard, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.ao.description: Contact shading in creases and where objects meet. Levels raise trace quality, from quarter to half to full resolution. The costliest effect here, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.bloom.description: Light bleeding from bright pixels. Costs very little, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.dlss_quality.descripti: Which render resolution DLSS starts from. DLAA runs at native resolution and spends the whole budget on image quality, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.dof.description: Blurs what a game marks as out of focus. Levels add blur samples. Costs nothing unless a game calls for it, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.fog.description: Light scattering through fog and smoke. Levels raise the fog volume from 60x40x32 to 320x200x128, which accounts for most of the cost, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.fsr1_sharpness.descrip: How hard FSR sharpens the upscaled image. Too much makes the edges harsh, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.fsr3_quality.descripti: Which render resolution FSR3 starts from. Native still runs the temporal pass, so it provides anti-aliasing rather than upscaling, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.fsr3_sharpness.descrip: How hard FSR3 sharpens yer upscaled image.
menu.settings.gfx.motionblur.description: How far the blur smears. 0 stops motion blur, even in games that call for it, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.motionblur_quality.des: Levels take 4, 12 or 16 samples along movement. Cheap in every case, matey; strength decides whether it blurs at all.
menu.settings.gfx.postprocess.descriptio: Sets all the effects below in one stroke, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.shadows.description: Shadow map resolution, how far the sun casts shadows, and how many lights cast them. One of the heaviest settings in a busy scene, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.ssr.description: Reflects on-screen geometry off glossy surfaces. Levels trace at quarter, half, then full resolution, with rising cost, matey.
menu.settings.gfx.texture.description: The resolution textures stream in at, plus anisotropic filtering. Costs video memory rather than frame time, so lower it if yer VRAM runs short.
menu.settings.gfx.upscaler.description: Renders below display resolution and scales up. Cheap extra frame rate, matey, at a visible cost to sharpness — worst on text and fine detail.
menu.settings.gfx.upscaler_scale.descrip: Share of display resolution used to draw the scene. Lower runs faster but looks softer, matey.
menu.settings.graphics.blurb: What it costs to draw yer scene.
